description: Create an empty list of values.
Add a value to a copy of a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and missing or null value input uses null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to copy before adding a value. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to append. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the copied list with the value appended.

description: Remove the first matching value from a copy of a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and missing or null value input uses null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to copy before removing a value. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to remove. Missing or null input uses null. No match leaves the copied list unchanged.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the copied list without its first matching value, or unchanged when no match exists.

description: Remove one item by zero-based index from a copied list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, index defaults to 0, and an invalid index leaves the copied list unchanged.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to copy before removing an item. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based item index. Missing or null input uses 0. A negative or out-of-range index leaves the copied list unchanged.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the copied list after removal, or unchanged when the index is invalid.

description: Return an empty copy of a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to copy and clear. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

description: Read one item by zero-based index. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, index defaults to 0, and an invalid index returns null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to read. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based item index. Missing or null input uses 0. A negative or out-of-range index returns null.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the item at the index, or null when the index is invalid.

description: Replace one item by zero-based index in a copied list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, index defaults to 0, value defaults to null, and an invalid index leaves the copied list unchanged.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to copy before replacing an item. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based item index. Missing or null input uses 0. A negative or out-of-range index leaves the copied list unchanged.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Replacement value. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the copied list after replacement, or unchanged when the index is invalid.

description: Count the items in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list and returns 0.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to count. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: size
outputs.description: Returns the number of items, or 0 when the list is missing or null.

description: Check whether a list has no items. Missing or null list input uses an empty list and returns true.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to check. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: empty
outputs.description: Returns true when the list has no items, including when the input is missing or null.

description: Check whether a list contains a value. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and missing or null value input uses null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to find. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: contains
outputs.description: Returns true when the list contains the value and false otherwise.

description: Insert a value at a zero-based index in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, index defaults to 0, value defaults to null, and an invalid index leaves the list unchanged.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to update. Missing or null input uses an empty list. Inputs over 65536 items fail before output.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based insertion index. Missing or null input uses 0. A negative or out-of-range index leaves the list unchanged.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to insert. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the list after insertion, or unchanged when the index is invalid.

description: Insert an item at a zero-based index in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, index defaults to 0, item defaults to null, and an invalid index leaves the list unchanged.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to update. Missing or null input uses an empty list. Inputs over 65536 items fail before output.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based insertion index. Missing or null input uses 0. A negative or out-of-range index leaves the list unchanged.

inputs.name: item
inputs.description: Item to insert. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the list after insertion, or unchanged when the index is invalid.

description: Return the supplied values as a list. Missing or null input uses an empty list, and the values are retained in order.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Values to expose as a list. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns the supplied values in their original order.
